name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
author: Pluto Systems <https://plutosystems.co>
description: A short inverted label that opens on hover and focus, closes on Escape, and repeats an icon button's name.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Tooltip as TooltipPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";
  import type { WithoutChildrenOrChild } from "$UTILS$";
  import TooltipPortal from "./tooltip-portal.svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    // bits-ui takes a number, not a CSS value: the 4 px ladder step.
    sideOffset = 4,
    side = "top",
    children,
    portalProps,
    ...restProps
  }: TooltipPrimitive.ContentProps & {
    portalProps?: WithoutChildrenOrChild<ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPortal>>;
  } = $props();
</script>

<!--
  An inverted chip, so it stands out without elevation. It fades in and out
  over the micro budget. It is never an icon button's only name. bits-ui
  gives the content no role, so it is set here.
-->
<TooltipPortal {...portalProps}>
  <TooltipPrimitive.Content
    bind:ref
    data-slot="tooltip-content"
    role="tooltip"
    {sideOffset}
    {side}
    class={cn(
      "z-50 inline-flex w-fit max-w-xs origin-(--bits-tooltip-content-transform-origin) items-center gap-2 rounded bg-foreground px-3 py-2 text-xs text-background data-open:animate-enter data-[state=delayed-open]:animate-enter data-[state=instant-open]:animate-enter data-closed:animate-exit",
      className,
    )}
    {...restProps}
  >
    {@render children?.()}
  </TooltipPrimitive.Content>
</TooltipPortal>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Tooltip as TooltipPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { ...restProps }: TooltipPrimitive.PortalProps = $props();
</script>

<TooltipPrimitive.Portal {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Tooltip as TooltipPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { delayDuration = 0, ...restProps }: TooltipPrimitive.ProviderProps =
    $props();
</script>

<TooltipPrimitive.Provider {delayDuration} {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts" generics="T = never">
  import { Tooltip as TooltipPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { getContext } from "svelte";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    onfocus,
    onkeydown,
    onpointerdown,
    onpointerleave,
    ...restProps
  }: TooltipPrimitive.TriggerProps<T> = $props();

  const keyboard = getContext<
    { trigger: HTMLElement | null; dismissed: boolean } | undefined
  >("pluto:tooltip");

  $effect(() => {
    if (keyboard) keyboard.trigger = ref;
  });

  type Handler<E extends Event> =
    | ((event: E & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) => void)
    | null
    | undefined;

  function call<E extends Event>(handler: unknown, event: E) {
    (handler as Handler<E>)?.(
      event as E & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement },
    );
  }
</script>

<!-- Escape and the pointer dismiss the tooltip for as long as focus stays. -->
<TooltipPrimitive.Trigger
  bind:ref
  data-slot="tooltip-trigger"
  onfocus={(event) => {
    if (keyboard) keyboard.dismissed = false;
    call(onfocus, event);
  }}
  onkeydown={(event) => {
    if (keyboard && event.key === "Escape") keyboard.dismissed = true;
    call(onkeydown, event);
  }}
  onpointerdown={(event) => {
    if (keyboard) keyboard.dismissed = true;
    call(onpointerdown, event);
  }}
  onpointerleave={(event) => {
    if (keyboard) keyboard.dismissed = true;
    call(onpointerleave, event);
  }}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts" generics="T = never">
  import { Tooltip as TooltipPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { setContext } from "svelte";

  let {
    open = $bindable(false),
    onOpenChange,
    ...restProps
  }: TooltipPrimitive.RootProps<T> = $props();

  /**
   * Shared with `TooltipTrigger`: its element, and whether the person
   * dismissed the tooltip (Escape, or the pointer) since focus arrived.
   */
  const keyboard: { trigger: HTMLElement | null; dismissed: boolean } = {
    trigger: null,
    dismissed: false,
  };
  setContext("pluto:tooltip", keyboard);

  /**
   * bits-ui closes an open tooltip on any scroll around its trigger, and Tab
   * to a trigger below the fold scrolls the page, so the tooltip would vanish
   * while focus stays. If it closes while the trigger still has keyboard focus
   * and no one dismissed it, open it again on the next frame (SC 1.4.13).
   */
  function handleOpenChange(next: boolean) {
    onOpenChange?.(next);
    if (next) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const trigger = keyboard.trigger;
      if (
        !open &&
        !keyboard.dismissed &&
        trigger &&
        trigger === document.activeElement &&
        trigger.matches(":focus-visible")
      )
        open = true;
    });
  }
</script>

<TooltipPrimitive.Root
  bind:open
  onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
  {...restProps}
/>
